# Sober: Sobriety Day Counter

> Sober is a free sobriety day counter app for iPhone and Apple Watch. Count days sober, check in daily, grow a bonsai garden and add a widget. No account needed.

## App

- [Sober: Sobriety Day Counter App for iPhone & Apple Watch](https://jackwallner.com/ios/sober/index.html.md): Sober is a free sobriety day counter app for iPhone and Apple Watch. Count days sober, check in daily, grow a bonsai garden and add a widget. No account needed.

## Guides

- [Free App With a Breathing Exercise for a Drinking Craving](https://jackwallner.com/ios/sober/drinking-craving-breathing-app.html.md): Sober: Sobriety Day Counter has a free craving mode: tap I'm having a craving for a full-screen box-breathing session. No paywall and no account.
- [Dry January App to Track Alcohol-Free Days on a Calendar](https://jackwallner.com/ios/sober/dry-january-tracker-app.html.md): Sober: Sobriety Day Counter is a free iPhone and Apple Watch app that counts alcohol-free days on a month calendar, with a countdown to January 31.
- [Free Sobriety Tracker With No Account or Paywall on the Basics](https://jackwallner.com/ios/sober/free-sobriety-tracker-no-account.html.md): Sober: Sobriety Day Counter is a free sobriety tracker for iPhone with no account. The counter, check-in, calendar, widgets and Apple Watch app are free.
- [I Am Sober Alternatives: 5 Sobriety Apps Compared](https://jackwallner.com/ios/sober/i-am-sober-alternative.html.md): Five iPhone sobriety counters compared as I Am Sober alternatives: I Am Sober, Sober Time, Days Since, Sober Day and Sober. Facts as of October 2026.
- [Sober Counter With an Apple Watch App and Lock Screen Widget](https://jackwallner.com/ios/sober/sober-counter-apple-watch-lock-screen-widget.html.md): Sober: Sobriety Day Counter shows your days sober on the iPhone Lock Screen, the Home Screen and Apple Watch. The widgets and the Watch app are free.
- [Sobriety App That Keeps Your Progress After a Slip](https://jackwallner.com/ios/sober/sobriety-app-slip-keeps-progress.html.md): In Sober: Sobriety Day Counter a slip restarts the counter, but your bonsai keeps half its growth and your streaks and calendar stay. Free, no account.
- [Sobriety Counter App for Android: Sober on Google Play](https://jackwallner.com/ios/sober/sobriety-counter-app-android.html.md): Sobriety counter app for Android: Sober: Sobriety Day Counter counts alcohol-free days, with a daily check-in, calendar, craving breathing and a widget.
- [Sobriety Milestones: What 30, 60, 90 Days and 1 Year Mean](https://jackwallner.com/ios/sober/sobriety-milestones.html.md): What sobriety milestones mean at 30, 60, 90 days and 1 year: chip traditions, what research shows after a month off alcohol, and how to mark each one.
